summary: Brell’s Sanctum is the central divine chamber of Underfoot, where stone, crystal, and magma unify under Brell Serilis’ authority. The Sanctum Guardian protects the heart of the subterranean cosmos.
history: The Sanctum was shaped from the first stone Brell ever blessed.
Crystal altars formed where divine resonance pooled.
Magma fountains were created to stabilize subterranean energy.
The Sanctum Guardian arose as the living embodiment of Brell’s will.
